title: Hotel Rate Plans Contracting Schedule: Sale Limits by Plan
content:
Every one of the seven Hotel Rate Plans is sold inside the limits recorded against it below. The figures are properties of the plan itself: they travel with the plan whatever property, season or channel the reservation is taken through.

## Schedule of sale limits

| Rate plan | Advance purchase, calendar days | Minimum nights | Maximum nights | Booking window, calendar days | Largest number of rooms on one reservation | Rooms from which the group desk takes the booking |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 7 | 1 | 14 | 330 | 3 | 4 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 21 | 2 | 21 | 365 | 3 | 4 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 3 | 1 | 28 | 365 | 5 | 6 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 0 | 1 | 30 | 365 | 8 | 9 |
| Member Flex Rate | 0 | 1 | 30 | 365 | 8 | 9 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 3 | 2 | 21 | 365 | 4 | 5 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 14 | 3 | 21 | 400 | 4 | 5 |

## What each column records

1. **Advance purchase** is the minimum number of calendar days between booking and arrival for the rate plan to be sold at all.
2. **Minimum nights** and **maximum nights** are the shortest and the longest stay the rate plan may be booked for.
3. **Booking window** is the furthest ahead of arrival, in calendar days, that the rate plan may be booked.
4. **Largest number of rooms** is the most rooms one reservation may hold before group terms apply.
5. **Group threshold** is the number of rooms from which the group desk takes the booking instead.

## Reading the schedule at its edges

A stay of 14 nights sits exactly at the maximum the Non-Refundable Saver Rate records, and a stay of 15 nights lies outside it; the same stay of 15 nights sits inside the 28 nights the Semi-Flexible Rate records. A party wanting 5 rooms sits inside the 5 rooms the Semi-Flexible Rate records as its largest reservation and at the same time reaches the 5 rooms from which the Suite Flexible Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate pass the booking to the group desk. The Standard Flexible Rate and the Member Flex Rate record 0 advance purchase days, so an arrival on the day of booking is not beyond their advance-purchase figure; the All-Inclusive Flex Rate records 14, and an arrival 13 days away is.
